basic_info.description: Luxurious top floor Potrero Hill residence!  This extensively remodeled residence boasts soaring ceilings, massive sliding glass doors opening to four private terraces.  The spacious great room is open to a luxurious chef's kitchen including Fisher & Paykel appliances, two-tone cabinetry, Krion countertops with bar-top seating.  The primary suite in on the main level while two spacious bedrooms are located on the top floor; all bedrooms have massive private terraces. Residence features underfloor heating, in-unit laundry hook-ups and way too many features to describe.  Most see to believe!
